claude.performance_metric: SEC registration revoked April 24, 2019; no audited public financial record for window
claude.rationale: The slice documents only that the registrant, a Chapter 11 debtor that sold substantially all operating assets, ceased periodic public reporting after a February 2016 monthly operating report and had its Exchange Act registration revoked on April 24, 2019. No audited financial record exists for the window, and the slice contains no documented evidence describing any product/process interface disruption (p4) or any process/organization fracture between operations and people/management/culture (p5). Because there is no realized-outcome evidence bearing on either interface, both pathways are coded uncertain rather than 0, and the archetype/business-model channels likewise lack any documented record.
